training: Expanding chronological bar prefix from January 1; no parameter fitting. Earlier evaluation days enter later bar prefixes.
holdout_scope: Untouched strategy outcomes, not unseen prices: full January price-quality audit already published.

base.basis: Uncalibrated legacy USD assumptions; base scenario; spread embedded in source bid/ask

stress.basis: Uncalibrated legacy USD assumptions; stress scenario; spread embedded in source bid/ask

cost_scope: Generic uncalibrated USD research assumptions, not actual broker tariff. Source bid/ask spread embedded, never subtracted twice. Legacy elapsed-day financing retained, not actual rollover.
readiness_scope: Historical news/calendar/history readiness assumed. Original arrival/revision/session availability unqualified.
comparator: No trade: zero trading PnL, cost and drawdown; cash interest excluded.
execution: 16 serial full-day pair/arm sessions, every tick, 300000-tick/session bound; independent USD10000 accounts. Stop on any failed or nonflat session; no retry, resampling, forced close or hidden reset.
selection_rule: After all16 verified flat: reject promotion if any pair/arm final holdout net return <=0 or fewer than2of3 prior fold returns >0 for any pair/arm; otherwise keep for further research only. Incomplete evidence returns insufficient. No statistical acceptance, annualization, summed returns or live promotion.
uncertainty: Four dates from one month, correlated pairs and scenarios, few trades; report individual outcomes and ranges, no independence/significance claims.
